timeInvoiceDesc: Select completed, billable hours from your team's accessible client projects.
legacyInvoices: This client has invoices from the previous time-billing workflow. Those invoices have no linked time records. Review them before selecting hours to avoid billing past work again.
noHours: No unbilled, completed billable hours in this period.
firstEntries: Showing the first 500 entries. Narrow the dates or invoice these entries first.
fallbackDesc: Only used for entries without a recorded rate.
uncertain: The result could not be confirmed. Retry with this selection to recover the invoice safely.
creationError: Could not confirm creation. Retry to check this same invoice.
trackedDesc: Hours and rates recorded when this invoice was created.
noTracked: This invoice has no linked time records.
deleteInvoice: Are you sure you want to delete this invoice?
